## Objective
- Build a complete, playable local two-player boxing game with realistic movement, defense, stamina, and rounds.
- Expand the punches to include boxing straights, hooks, and uppercuts to the head and body, with distinct punch animations.

## Requirements
- RED moves with WASD and slips with Q/E; BLUE moves with arrow keys and slips with comma/period.
- Support head/body health, stamina, guarding, rolling, clinching, and movement around the ring.
- Add straight punches to head and body, left and right hooks to head and body, and uppercuts to head and body, with proper animations.

## Decisions
- Retain the browser canvas game, local keyboard controls, and best-of-three rounds.
- Punch controls now select a punch type; holding Shift while pressing the punch key targets the body.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented separate head/body health, movement, slips, rolls, guarding, clinching, and round flow.
- Added punch mappings: RED J jab, K cross, L lead/left hook, ; rear/right hook, H uppercut; BLUE 1 jab, 2 cross, 3 lead/left hook, 4 rear/right hook, 6 uppercut. Shift modifies these attacks to target the body.
- Reworked punch animation rendering to distinguish straight, hook, and uppercut styles, lead/rear arms, and head/body trajectories.
- Previous browser tests confirmed timer progression, stamina use, and jab damage; `node --check game.js` previously passed before the latest punch changes.

### Active
- Finish and test the expanded punch controls, body targeting, hit resolution, and animations.
- Update the on-page control hints to match the changed punch mappings and Shift body-shot modifier.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` and browser-test each punch against head and body targets, including animations and damage.
2. Update the control hints in `index.html` to reflect the new keys and Shift targeting.
3. Check browser console; previously observed errors were only missing `/favicon.ico` (404).

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Punch controls, combat resolution, animations, and game logic.
- `index.html`: In-game and footer control instructions that need updating.
- `style.css`: Layout and control-hint styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The game is served at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The current `index.html` hints still describe the earlier punch controls and do not explain Shift body targeting.

## Objective
- Complete the local two-player boxing game with realistic movement, defense, stamina, and rounds.
- Support distinct head/body straight punches, hooks, and uppercuts with fitting animations.

## Requirements
- RED uses WASD to move, Q/E to slip, and BLUE uses arrow keys to move, comma/period to slip.
- Support head/body health, stamina, guarding, rolling, clinching, ring movement, and best-of-three rounds.
- Include jab, cross, left/right hook, and uppercut; each can target head or body.

## Decisions
- Retain the browser canvas game and local keyboard controls.
- Punch keys select punch types; hold Shift while pressing a punch key to target the body.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented head/body health, movement, defense, clinching, and round flow.
- Added punch mappings and separate straight, hook, and uppercut animations for lead/rear arms and head/body trajectories.
- Updated the on-page controls in `index.html` to match punch mappings and Shift body targeting.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` pass; browser smoke test reported no console errors and confirmed damage from some punches.

### Active
- Validate that all punch types consistently resolve damage to both head and body; browser testing produced zero-damage results for several attempted punches, possibly due to range or test setup.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Re-test each RED and BLUE punch against both targets at reliable range, and determine why some browser-test attempts did not register damage.
2. Fix any confirmed hit-resolution or control issues, then rerun syntax and browser checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Punch mappings, hit resolution, animations, and game logic.
- `index.html`: Intro hint and in-game control instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- RED punches: J jab, K cross, L lead/left hook, ; rear/right hook, H uppercut. BLUE punches: 1 jab, 2 cross, 3 lead/left hook, 4 rear/right hook, 6 uppercut. Shift targets the body.
- Browser damage checks registered several head punches, but multiple attacks on both players showed no damage; the test setup may have affected range or spacing.

- Complete the local two-player boxing game with realistic movement, defense, stamina, and rounds.
- Support distinct head/body punches with fitting animations and controls.

## Requirements
- RED uses WASD, Q/E to slip; BLUE uses arrow keys, comma/period to slip.
- Support head/body health, stamina, guarding, rolling, clinching, ring movement, and best-of-three rounds.
- Include jab, cross, left/right hook, and uppercut, each targeting head or body.

## Decisions
- Retain the browser canvas game and local keyboard controls.
- Hold Shift while pressing a punch key to target the body.

### Completed
- Implemented head/body health, movement, defense, clinching, rounds, punch mappings, and distinct punch animations.

- (none)

1. Diagnose the inconsistent browser test results and verify all ten punch types across both fighters and target zones at reliable range.
2. Fix any confirmed hit-resolution or control issues, then rerun syntax, diff, and browser checks.

- `game.js`: Punch mappings, hit resolution, animations, and game logic.
- `index.html`: Intro hint and in-game control instructions.

## Objective
- Complete the local two-player boxing game with realistic movement, defense, stamina, and best-of-three rounds.
- Ensure all punch types reliably hit the head or body for both fighters.

## Requirements
- RED uses WASD and Q/E to slip; BLUE uses arrow keys and comma/period to slip.
- Support head/body health, stamina, guarding, rolling, clinching, ring movement, and best-of-three rounds.
- Include jab, cross, left/right hook, and uppercut, each targeting head or body.

## Decisions
- Retain the browser canvas game and local keyboard controls.
- Hold Shift while pressing a punch key to target the body.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented head/body health, movement, defense, clinching, rounds, punch mappings, and distinct punch animations.
- Updated control instructions in `index.html`.
- Increased hit range threshold in `game.js` from `reach + .06` to `reach + .09`.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed after the range change.
- Browser tests confirmed some RED and BLUE head/body attacks can register damage; no JavaScript exceptions were observed.

### Active
- Reliably validate all five punch types, both target zones, and both fighters; browser attempts remain inconsistent and frequently report `JUST OUT OF RANGE`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect hit distance and movement/positioning behavior to establish a repeatable testing position.
2. Verify all 20 fighter/type/target combinations and fix any confirmed hit-resolution or control issues.
3. Rerun syntax, diff, and browser checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Punch mappings, hit resolution, animations, and game logic.
- `index.html`: Intro hint and in-game control instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files currently appear as untracked in `git status`.
- RED punches: J jab, K cross, L lead/left hook, ; rear/right hook, H uppercut. BLUE punches: 1 jab, 2 cross, 3 lead/left hook, 4 rear/right hook, 6 uppercut. Shift targets the body.
- Browser hit tests showed that attacks can work for both fighters, but coverage of all moves/zones is incomplete; the latest test run yielded zero damage and `JUST OUT OF RANGE` callouts.
- `game.js` hit check is at `attackUpdate`; it compares horizontal distance with scaled punch reach plus `.09` and requires depth difference below `.30`.

## Objective
- Complete the local two-player boxing game with reliable punches, realistic movement and defense, stamina, and best-of-three rounds.
- New request: “make it all 3d add illiagal shots” (interpreted as make the game fully 3D and add illegal shots).

## Requirements
- RED controls: WASD, Q/E slips; BLUE controls: arrows, comma/period slips.
- Support head/body health, stamina, guarding, rolling, clinching, ring movement, and best-of-three rounds.
- Both players need jab, cross, left/right hook, and uppercut targeting head or body.
- Hold Shift while pressing a punch key to target the body.
- Make the game all 3D and add illegal shots.

## Decisions
- Existing implementation is a browser canvas game with local keyboard controls.
- Punch mappings: RED J/K/L/;/H; BLUE 1/2/3/4/6.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented head/body health, movement, defense, clinching, rounds, punch mappings, and distinct punch animations.
- Updated control instructions in `index.html`.
- Increased hit range threshold in `game.js` from `reach + .06` to `reach + .09`, then to `reach + .15`.
- Verified all 10 punch types (five moves for each fighter) register head damage in browser tests after the `.15` range adjustment; no JavaScript exceptions observed.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest range adjustment.

### Active
- Convert the game to fully 3D.
- Add illegal shots.
- Finish repeatable validation of all 20 fighter/move/target-zone combinations; earlier head/body tests were inconsistent, and the latest comprehensive test is still running.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the result of the running 20-case browser test when its completion arrives.
2. Plan and implement the requested full 3D conversion and illegal-shot mechanics.
3. Re-run syntax, diff, and browser validation, including all fighters, moves, and target zones.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, hit resolution, controls, rendering, movement, and animations.
- `index.html`: Game UI and control instructions.
- `style.css`: Game layout and presentation.

## Important Context
- Project files appear untracked in `git status`; changes are uncommitted.
- Hit check is in `attackUpdate`; it compares horizontal distance with scaled reach plus `.15` and requires depth difference below `.30`.
- Prior hit testing had inconsistent results; after adjusting reach to `.15`, all head attacks registered, while body tests were not yet fully completed.
